chunks: 74 - Abu Ja‘far al-Baqir عليه السلام said: “Shall I not describe to you the wudu (ablution) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله?” It was said to him: “Yes.”

Then he called for a bowl in which there was some water and placed it before him. Then he uncovered his forearms, then dipped his right palm into it and said: “This is when the palm is pure.” Then he scooped a palmful of water, placed it on his forehead, and said: “In the Name of Allah,” and let it flow over the edges of his beard. Then he passed his hand over his face and the outer part of his forehead once. Then he dipped his left hand and scooped with it a palmful, then placed it on his right elbow and passed his palm over his forearm until the water flowed to the tips of his fingers. Then he scooped a palmful with his right hand and placed it on his left elbow, then passed his palm over his forearm until the water flowed to the tips of his fingers. And he wiped the front of his head and the upper part of his feet with the remaining moisture of his water.

key_terms.الْكَفُّ: the palm/hand, mentioned regarding its state of purity before dipping
key_terms.بِبِلَّةِ: with the moisture, referring to the remaining wetness used for wiping
key_terms.جَبْهَتِهِ: his forehead, where the water was first placed for washing the face
key_terms.ظَهْرِ قَدَمَيْهِ: the upper part of his feet, which were wiped
key_terms.لِحْيَتِهِ: his beard, over whose edges the water was made to flow
key_terms.مُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ: the front of his head, which was wiped
key_terms.مِرْفَقِهِ: his elbow, the starting point for washing the arms
key_terms.وُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification being described

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله perform wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the wudu (ablution) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله as demonstrated by Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام. It outlines the sequence of washing the face and arms, followed by wiping the front of the head and the feet with the remaining moisture, making it an important text in the fiqh of ritual purity.
